name: wbr-opportunity
note: <wbr> is a zero-width soft wrap opportunity (HTML Standard): a 100px box with longword<wbr>continued breaks at the wbr (two lines, the wbr contributes no advance), while the identical word without a wbr keeps one overflowing line (overflow-wrap: normal never breaks inside a word). Both targets are id'd spans so the layer-3 rects pin the line fragments; the wbr itself stays invisible.
